text:
ops-bot: SLO ALERT: hosted-infer-usw2 p95 latency > 3s for last 5m (SLO burn 12%). Link: https://console.redwood/slo/hosted-infer-usw2 :rotating_light:

alisa: seeing it on the dashboard, zooming in now. dashboard: https://console.redwood/dash/hosted-infer-usw2/latency

mari: a customer (acct: acme-inc) just opened a support ticket complaining about 503s and slow responses 10:02 UTC. Ticket# 2026-2745

ben: can we get a sample request-id from the tickets? need to correlate with traces/logs. mari, can you paste payload or req-id?

mari: pasted into ticket: req_id=rx-9f34a2c7. Customer says they hit this repeatedly from a batched job.

alisa: running a fast log query for that req_id across ingress and gateway:```query
index=ingress logs | where req_id=="rx-9f34a2c7" | sort @ts asc | limit 100
```

alisa: results show ingress->gateway handshake took ~1.8s then gateway->runtime timed out with 504. Multiple retries from client.

ben: interesting. Any 5xx spikes in upstream GPU pool?

alisa: checking model pool metrics: p95 token-latency for rtx-pool spiked from 120ms to 1.6s for short requests around 10:00-10:06. No OOMs. CPU util on proxy nodes also higher.

tracing-bot: Trace gaps detected: 27% of traces missing spans between gateway and runtime for that window. Missing spans correlate with POD restarts on gateway-frontend-2.

derek: gateway-frontend-2 shows a SIGTERM around 10:03 then quick restart. kube events show liveness probe flapped twice. Reason: ephemeral TCP exhaustion (socket backlog).

ben: could be ephem fd leak or burst of parallel connections from batched jobs. mari, any rate info from customer?

mari: customer confirmed they had a concurrent job surge at 10:00 — they sent parallel 500 reqs in ~30s as part of nightly analytics.

alisa: repro plan: ask customer to run a small parallelized curl (10 concurrent) against hosted endpoint with header x-test-repro and req_id, see if we hit same. Provide guidance to use backoff and connection pooling.

ben: for hotfix, scaling gateway-frontend replicas + increase net.core.somaxconn and systemd socket backlog on frontends should reduce liveness flaps. I'll open a runbook PR with commands.

alisa: quick mitigation applied: bumped gateway-frontend replicas from 3->5 in usw2 and raised somaxconn on frontends. Monitoring 2m.

ops-bot: Mitigation deployed by ben at 10:12 UTC.

alisa: after scale, p95 latency dropped back to 210ms and SLO burn cleared to 1.2%. traces show gap rate down to 2%.

mari: replied to customer with explanation + recommended rate limits and suggested retry/backoff pattern. Customer acknowledged and will stagger jobs.

ben: follow-ups: 1) add proactive alert for trace-gap > 10% 2) add connection backlog tuning to infra bootstrap 3) add guidance to support KB about high-concurrency batched jobs. I'll own 1+2.

derek: I'll open a postmortem draft with timeline and POD event logs. tagging for ops review.

alisa: thanks team. marking thread for after-action review. :white_check_mark:
